## Rule

ARC-GEN source: `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_0ca9ddb6.py`.

Fixed 9x9 grid. Input contains 1-6 sampled pixels with colors in `{1,2,6,8}`. Colors 1 and 2 are "twinklers" and are scooched off the edge; sampled pixels are kept only when their twinkle radius does not clobber a previous sampled pixel. Output copies the input, then:
- color 1 stamps color 7 into its rook-neighbor cells `(r+-1,c),(r,c+-1)`.
- color 2 stamps color 4 into its bishop-neighbor cells `(r+-1,c+-1),(r+-1,c+1),(r+1,c+-1),(r+1,c+1)`.
- colors 6 and 8 are copied only.

Bundled data check 2026-06-12: 3 train + 1 test + 261 arc-gen pairs; every input/output shape is 9x9 and the only output colors are `{0,1,2,4,6,7,8}`.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = copy(input)
for r, c, color in sampled_pixels:
    if color == 1:
        for dr, dc in [(1,0), (-1,0), (0,1), (0,-1)]:
            out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7
    elif color == 2:
        for dr, dc in [(1,1), (-1,1), (1,-1), (-1,-1)]:
            out[r + dr][c + dc] = 4
```

## Cost analysis

Current artifact is a single output-writing F32 Conv with no charged intermediates: score_v2 `(macs=0, memory=0, params=900)`, real-input profile `memory 0 + params 900 = 900` over train/test + full bundled arc-gen (`--arcgen 266`, 265 real inputs in this repo: 4 official + 261 arc-gen).

Team-best refresh 2026-06-24: `../K-NeuroGolf-OnnxlyFans/Team_Submission/Backend/manifest.csv` row is `task015, Aditya, cost 900`, SHA256 `1ab641692d1424be973ca0ca5d26e88172d7be86363973c99ffda1b0d2dfd046`, updated UTC `2026-06-19T12:21:50Z`. `../K-NeuroGolf-OnnxlyFans/NG_OnnxlyFans_TaskStatus.xlsx` agrees (`Tasks` sheet: owner Aditya, assigned Boladi, cost 900, `sha12=1ab641692d14`).

New staged candidate 2026-06-24: `staged_submits/task015_active9_einsum_cost848/task015.onnx`, static/profile cost **848** `(macs=0, memory=0, params=848)`, SHA256 `5611ddb972b561e12aa1693b696ed75f0215462193a0ef126d16f880ecb77684`, expected cost delta `-52` vs team-best 900 (points delta `ln(900/848) ~= +0.0595`). It is byte-equal to LIVE on full A-B and full ARC-GEN truth clean.

Dominant charged tensor: initializer `conv_weight` shape `[10,10,3,3]` = 900 params. Weight structure:
- center `[*,*,1,1]` is the 10x10 identity.
- output ch0 has `-1` taps from input ch1 rook-neighbors and input ch2 bishop-neighbors to erase background where twinkles are painted.
- output ch7 has `+1` taps from input ch1 rook-neighbors.
- output ch4 has `+1` taps from input ch2 bishop-neighbors.

### Sub-900 formulation kill table

| cheaper formulation class | cheapest measured/priced rung | verdict | reason |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Active-grid free-output Einsum | **848** | **STAGED WIN** | fixed 9x9 active-grid factorization replaces full `B[2,30,30]` with `S[30,9]` + `B[2,9,9]`; one final output-writing `Einsum` avoids charged intermediates |
| Center-only 1x1 Conv / Gather / identity copy | 100 | visible `0/265` | off-center stencil taps are semantically live |
| Grouped Conv, `group=2` | 450 | visible `96/265` | output ch7 must read input ch1, but group-2 puts output ch7 in the input 5-9 partition |
| Grouped Conv, `group=5` | 180 | visible `0/265` | output ch4 cannot read input ch2 and output ch7 cannot read input ch1 under contiguous group partitions |
| Depthwise Conv / channelwise morphology | 90 for depthwise Conv, 0 for MaxPool probe | visible `0/265` | same-channel ops can dilate ch1 or ch2 but cannot recolor into output channels 7 and 4 or erase ch0 |
| Separable split of final Conv | parameter-saving only; first split intermediate at least `[1,1,30,30]` F32 = 3,600 B, and practical splits are wider | killed by cost | free-output separability trap: the dense final Conv charges only params, while any split charges the first Conv output |
| Pre/post channel reorder around grouped Conv | reorder/crop intermediate at least `[1,10,9,9]` F32 = 3,240 B; full canvas = 36,000 B | killed by cost | reorder cost exceeds the entire 900-param dense Conv before the grouped Conv is counted |
| Scalar color-index canvas + Equal/OneHot tail | at least one `[1,1,30,30]` canvas = 900 B plus decoder chain; fixed-9 input slice alone is 3,240 B | killed by cost | the final Equal can be free, but producing the dynamic canvas is already not sub-900 from raw one-hot input |
| Full-canvas free-output Einsum with spatial-shift bases | **MEASURED 2026-06-22: 2216** (`B[2,30,30]=1800` + `Ksel[4,10,10]=400` + picks; visible 265/265, truth 200000/200000, profile==static) | killed only in this full-canvas formulation | the old `N[30,30]` `+-1` band basis is too expensive; the 2026-06-24 active-grid factorization is the winning escape |
| ScatterND tiny patch / sparse writes | fixed all-cells update needs at least an 81-cell update tensor plus indices; dynamic source extraction needs full masks or banned/nontrivial index decode | killed by cost/legality | task has up to six dynamic sources; no legal sub-900 route computes and writes variable neighbor patches from raw one-hot input |

Floor status: **no absolute floor claimed**. The previous full-canvas free-output floor was formulation-relative and is now superseded by the active-9 factorization. Current staged cost decomposition is `Ksel[4,10,10]=400`, `S[30,9]=270`, `B[2,9,9]=162`, `Rpick/Cpick=16`, total 848. Further improvement would need to compress the dense channel selector `Ksel` or the active-grid selector/basis without birthing a charged plane; the known local-stencil, grouped, depthwise, crop/canvas, and full-canvas free-output alternatives are either visible-failed or priced above 848.

## Don't-do log

- Do not collapse to 1x1 Conv, Identity, or Gather; the off-center stencil is semantically necessary and center-only visible-gates `0/265`.
- Do not separable-split or channel-group this Conv unless a no-intermediate channel reorder primitive appears; ordinary Gather/Slice/Concat reorder costs more than the 900 params saved.
- Do not rebuild as scalar color-index canvas or ScatterND patch unless the scorer model changes; both price above the current single-output Conv.
- Do not re-attempt the **full-canvas** free-output separable Einsum (MEASURED 2216, 2026-06-22). The winning 2026-06-24 exception is to factor through the fixed active 9x9 grid (`S[30,9]` + `B[2,9,9]`) while keeping the final op output-writing.
